summary: Iteration 115 - Crystal Image Verification Testing. Backend API correctly returns per-crystal Wikipedia-backed image URLs with validation metadata for all 27 crystals. Iolite correctly maps to Cordierite Wikipedia article (regression fix verified). Frontend displays validation badges and handles image loading failures gracefully. Some Wikipedia images show 'Image unavailable' due to Wikimedia CDN rate limiting (HTTP 429) - this is transient external behavior, not a bug.

issues: Some crystals (Iolite, Sunstone, Aquamarine, Kunzite, Amazonite, Angelite) show 'Image unavailable' due to Wikipedia CDN rate limiting (HTTP 429). This is transient external behavior - images load correctly when not rate limited.

details: All crystals have image_validation object with status=verified
Iolite correctly maps to Cordierite Wikipedia article
All resolved URLs are valid Wikipedia/Wikimedia HTTPS URLs
Single crystal endpoint /api/crystals/deep/{id} returns enriched data
Validation badges display ('Verified image' or 'Needs review')
Image error handling works (fallback to 'Image unavailable')

wikipedia_rate_limiting_note: Wikipedia/Wikimedia CDN returns HTTP 429 for some image requests. This causes frontend to show 'Image unavailable' for affected crystals. This is transient external behavior - images load correctly when not rate limited. The backend caches validated image URLs in MongoDB to reduce Wikipedia API calls.
